let ⟨z₀, H₀⟩ := Hinh in
let rec findLeast lb :=
  if P lb then lb
  else findLeast (lb + 1)
in
let lb := findLeast b in
{ val := lb,
  property := by
    split
    · exact H₀
    · intro z hz
      apply Hb
      assumption }
